name: Good Medicine Is Hard to Come By
description: Maruf from Aaru Village seems to be having some trouble...

dialogs.content: *sigh* This condition is tricky. I'd better get Dr. Zakariya's help.
Is someone gravely ill?
Eh? Ah, Traveler! Nobody's gravely ill. It's just that a patient's got a severe case of headache.
I gave him some medicine, but it didn't really work that well.
Have you tried prescribing other medicine?
Ahem... That would've been far beyond me. You see, with my limited experience, I can only come up with this many prescriptions...
They can treat mild conditions alright, but when it comes to serious ones, they're next to useless.
Luckily, Dr. Zakariya at Bimarstan has offered to prescribe medicine and get the ingredients ready for me...
Traveler, can I ask you a favor?
I've got some patients to attend to, so could you visit Dr. Zakariya in my stead and ask him to prescribe something?
Leave it to me.
I'm counting on you, Traveler.
Does Zakariya ever come to the village?
He occasionally has people send herbs and stuff over, but he's too busy to show up in person, really.
Anyway, about that prescription — I'm counting on you, Traveler.

Why am I having more and more patients lately...
About Maruf...
Maruf? Did he run into some little-understood illness again?
You describe the condition Maruf is treating...
*sigh* How many times have I told him? He's fully capable of handling something this simple on his own — without needing my help!
I bet the patients are exaggerating their discomfort again, thinking that a mere village doctor is unable to treat their "serious illness."
That's why Maruf wants my prescription to reassure them.
Looking after the villagers for so many years has definitely not been an easy task for Maruf... I'll write up a prescription right away. Please take note, Traveler.
Um, I remember Maruf is treating a patient with...
A headache.
Ah, I see. To treat headaches, the prescription that I gave him last time will do.
Brew up a herbal soup out of the ingredients listed in the prescription and add three portions of <color=#00E1FFFF>Mint</color>.
After that, keep boiling the soup on a <color=#00E1FFFF>high flame</color> for around... Forget it... Boil it until <color=#00E1FFFF>the ingredients float</color>.
Um... Just in case you forget, I'll write it down.
Zakariya writes down the prescription...
Please deliver the prescription to Maruf.
To be honest, I wouldn't say what I prescribed is "medicine." Instead, it's more of a... How should I put it...
Well, it's more of a mild, nutritious supplement.
One can be as creative as they want with the prescription. The worst thing they might end up with is a useless soup, that's all.
*sigh* Actually, all Maruf had to do was to adjust his original prescription very slightly. Why couldn't he put more trust in himself?

About Zakariya's prescription...
It says to use the soup he prescribed last time as the base? I see... Let me check the instructions more carefully.
Eh? His writing is, um, unsurprisingly still so hard to understand.
Traveler, he told you how to brew it and what ingredients are needed, right?
Could you watch my steps? Let me know if I make any mistakes.
The ingredients are... Ugh... Totally unintelligible...
Starshroom.
How do I brew it?
Brew on a high flame throughout.

Until the ingredients float.
Got it. Allow me to check the prescription one more time, just in case we missed something.
